affinity.notes: Prismatic energy and crystal-light effects are the dominant construction.

anatomy.notes: Body, wings, crystal planes, and light streaks collapse into visual noise.

archetype.notes: Burst caster does not communicate the intended four-season arena sovereign duty.

counterplay.notes: Visual noise prevents a reliable read of attack origin, reach, or vulnerable body.

finish.notes: Competing rainbow highlights lack a stable material hierarchy.

framing.notes: Oversized diagonal effects obscure the combat silhouette.

identity.notes: Prismatic moth spirit identifies the Fae Monarch form.

tier.notes: Blind reviewer perceived T4, not exact intended tier T5.
